answer: A convincing sybil defense is vested payouts: rewards earned by an agent signal trust and are locked in a vesting schedule released over many epochs. A fresh identity, call it onyx, that joins to flash-farm would see most earnings forfeited on exit, so profit depends on surviving epochs of honest behavior. If each identity deposits a small stake, like a quill fee, the attacker multiplies locked capital by every fake account and still loses unvested rewards, making sybil farming unprofitable.
